description: Named the thirty-six shillings, and refused to name a man while the yard was emptying.
name: George Bryan

description: Gave Thursday without the comfort about the boxes, and named the waiting within the week.
name: John Heminges

description: Said the three galleries and the want of a laugh, and did not ask to be first on a paper.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Came for the reckoning only, took the thirty-six, and refused a settlement in the passage.
name: William Shakespeare
